text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One evening, while passing through the 
shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm? That's...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hey you two, looking all close over there! 
Care to give it a try~?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...So they say, Trainer-kun. Care to give 
it a try?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You mean having shown interest? It's 
simply that I've earned the right to 
participate.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Brian gave me a raffle ticket before. She 
said she didn't need it, so I could have 
it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, they did dump the punishment onto 
me, but isn't a lottery actually quite a 
fascinating game?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Depending on your luck, the prize can be 
big or small. That's when one's true worth 
is put to the test.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, it would tarnish my name as 
Symboli Rudolf, the 'Emperor', if I did 
not claim a prize worthy of the title."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In other words, what we're aiming for—is 
the grand prize, the 'Hot Springs Trip,' 
and nothing else.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, without further ado, shall we 
demonstrate our true worth?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Exchanging a nod with Symboli Rudolf, we 
gripped the lever together and spun the 
raffle drum.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh... It seems we were able to pull 
fortune to our side with our own hands.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm honestly really happy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, can't you tell? I'm jumping for joy 
far more than you think.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"However, now that I've actually hit the 
mark, I find myself a little bewildered."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed I do. Leisurly soaking in a hot 
spring amidst magnificent nature is the 
supreme form of bliss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"However... truly wishing for a carefree, 
leisurely life is far beyond what I 
deserve right now."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And so, there you have it. I'll leave that 
ticket in your care.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Whenever you feel the time is right 
to embark on our journey, please hand it 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I wish to entrust it to someone who can 
evaluate me fairly and squarely, without 
overestimating or underestimating me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh, no need to push yourself so hard.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best too, looking forward to 
the day we can journey together in 
harmony.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
When that day comes— I shall jump for joy 
with utmost delight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The hot springs ticket in my care felt 
heavy, but that just meant there was a 
wonderful treat to look forward to in the 
future."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see, this is a hefty, substantial 
hamburg steak truly deserving of the 
'special grade' title.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it has been a long time since I 
have seen such an opulent design."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
When I normally eat meat, I make a point 
of choosing lean steaks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Daily meals build the body. Though I'm 
sure you are already well aware.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even so, this is a reward. It would be a 
waste not to enjoy every bite.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Sprinkle the cheese, add some parsley on 
the side... Oh, how about we put a little 
flag on it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. For an exquisite item such as 
this, is it not the duty of the recipient 
to enjoy it to the fullest?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, she shared many more of her 
ideas on how to garnish the Salisbury 
steak.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see, this is much appreciated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As part of student council measures, we 
were just brainstorming an event that 
could help refresh and revitalize the 
students.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"With this many carrots, we might be able 
to prepare a special full-course meal."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let's quickly arrange something to see if 
we can pitch it to the cafeteria as a 
one-day-only menu item.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind helping out as well? Let's 
see... How does Minister of Taste-Testing 
sound?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you, Minister.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And thus, I was entrusted with this 
honorable duty.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Then a question for you, Trainer. 
Among the nutrients found in carrots, 
which one is worth noting?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Carotene is converted into Vitamin 
A in the body, maintaining healthy skin 
and mucous membranes. It also confers 
various other health-promoting benefits.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So then, how should it be prepared in 
order to efficiently absorb carotene?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, let me hear your answer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If possible, I'd like to hear a routine 
that makes the absolute most of this 
single piece.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back, we engaged in a heated 
debate over how best to bring out the 
delicious potential of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Tissues, huh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Come now, it is nothing to be disheartened 
over. Such is the peculiar charm of 
testing one's luck.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I was running low on pocket tissues 
anyway, so saving the trouble of 
restocking actually turned out for the 
best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the "Emperor," Symboli 
Rudolf. Just as I was admiring how she 
showed not a shred of disappointment—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By the way, my dear Trainer. Is there 
nothing else you need for today?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, there is still time before my 
next appointment. Since I went out of my 
way to stop by, I might as well—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzzzt, bzzzt...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me, time's up. Shall we head 
back to the academy?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was it just my imagination that her back 
looked a little lonely...?
